decisions.reason: Naval vessel lighting serves a robust specialist niche with long procurement cycles and rising defence demand, so results are likely at or above aspiration and slack lets the firm carry it.
The spring-balanced desk lamp still supports the ergonomic workplace portfolio, and with no evident shortfall against aspirations there is no trigger for problemistic search.
As a flagship microprismatic pendant aligned with the firm's efficient, glare-free direction, it carries strong strategic commitment and is very unlikely to be withdrawn.

HMI technology is under growing pressure from LED and may fall short of aspirations, but the marine line serves installed-base customers at low cost, so it is kept for now while LED alternatives mature.
The marine searchlight line complements the naval and specialist offering and shows no sign of underperformance that would justify reallocating its resources.
